title: Sick Emoji & Kaomoji: Copy & Paste 🤢🤮 Nauseous Combos
meta_description: Sick emoji 🤢 🤮 🥴, feverish and nauseous combo sets, plus queasy kaomoji like (×_×) for sick-day texts and chats. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
hero_tagline: Queasy green faces, fevers and cold sweats, mid-vomit reactions, and dizzy woozy kaomoji — every shade of feeling physically gross. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
intro: When you feel sick, one green face says it faster than a paragraph. This page gathers the whole queasy range: the 🤤 drooling and 🥴 woozy faces of a spinning head, the 🤢 nauseated and 🤮 vomiting faces for when it's actually coming up, the 🤒 thermometer, 😷 mask, and 🤧 sneeze of a fever or cold, and the 🥵 hot / 🥶 cold flashes with 💦 sweat. When an emoji won't carry the exact shade of gross, dizzy kaomoji like (×_×) and (@_@) paste anywhere plain text works. Grab a single face, or copy a ready-made combo set for sick-day texts, chats, and comments.
